subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer a single enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring an explicit `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the configured default account is disabled?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but the behavior changes fallback semantics that are currently documented as default-account fallback and may affect existing multi-account setups.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Preserve current semantics and document that users must set `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the configured default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned fallback
options.body: Ask for channel-owned behavior if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the prior shared-resolver direction and has direct history on the account-routing helper path.
